infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The compass heading is read from Core Location, and true north needs a location fix — without it the app can only report magnetic north and will say so.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Device motion supplies the gravity vector the app derives camera pitch and roll from.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera preview is the background the artificial horizon is drawn over, so a wrong pitch or roll sign is visible against the real horizon.
